in_marathi.name: Subramanyam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे The one with six arms and two heads
in_marathi.long_meaning: Subramanyam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Subra means six and manyam means arms. Subramanyam is a name of Lord Murugan who has six heads and twelve arms.
